summary.text: Jerry Schillinger is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 34 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and certified public accountant first elected in 2020, he serves on the Appropriations Committee and is vice chair of the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jerry Schillinger graduated from Circle High School and earned a degree in accounting from the University of Montana.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and a CPA.
Schillinger defeated Jacob Kitson in the November 3, 2020 general election for House District 37, won re-election there in 2022, and won in District 34 on November 5, 2024.
He chaired the House Ethics Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the House Rules Committee and is assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
